svg.title: Skylark system architecture
svg.desc: Exploded isometric view of four layers: Experience (Next.js App Router, React 19), Server (proxy.ts, Server Components, Server Actions, REST API), Domain services (matching, tailoring, reviews, pipeline) and Data (one Repository interface over Supabase Postgres with row level security, Auth and Storage, or an in-memory demo store). External services: Vercel Cron, job boards, Claude, Gemini, Razorpay, Google sign-in and SMTP.
